description_en: Retrieves the voice intercom address of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口获取IPC设备的语音对讲地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-voice-intercom --scheme rtmp --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y00000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryVoiceIntercom

parameters.help_en:
The connection protocol type for voice intercom. Valid values:

ws: WebSocket connection protocol. The web voice call address obtained by calling this operation when implementing voice intercom on the web. <props="china"><ph>For more information about implementing voice intercom between the web and the device, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2545966.html.</ph></props>
rtmp (default): The voice call address obtained by calling this operation when implementing voice intercom on Android and iOS application players. For more information about implementing voice intercom between Android and iOS applications and the device, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/260925.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/253953.html
parameters.help_zh:
语音对讲的连接协议类型。可取值：

ws：表示WebSocket连接协议。Web端实现语音对讲能力时，调用本接口获取的Web语音通话地址。<props="china"><ph>Web端与设备端实现语音对讲能力的详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2545966.html。</ph></props>
rtmp（默认）：Android和iOS应用端播放器实现语音对讲时，调用本接口获取的对应语音通话地址。Android和iOS应用端与设备端实现语音对讲能力的详细说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/260925.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/253953.html
parameters.name: scheme

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the information of all products under the current account on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页面或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页面查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation to query the device ID.

<notice> IotId is the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
